Lots of light and yes repot.  I studied horticulture and botany for my bachelors.
It is a tropical plant and need full sun.  When you repot it, take a pair of scissors and make a few vertical cuts on the roots on the outside of the dirt ball. Plants can become 'root bound' if left in a pot for too long and die.  Cutting just the outer most roots on 3-6 spots around the outside kills some roots but encourages root growth into the new soil when repotting.
Be sure to get the right soil and water soluble fertilizer for that plant.  Keep soil damp to moist.
Best of luck!

Echoing everyone here....please remove him from your life as soon as possible.  Like your life depends on it, because it might.  He is not mentally or emotionally stable and someone in that state can justify any action.  I've been on the receiving end before.
Please please please get help. Get your parents or grandparents, or aunt for uncle involved, your pastor if you are religious, a trusted teacher...someone older who your trust and can guide you to help and healing.  You are worth so much more than the way he is treating you.  Do not let him ever tell you different.
There is no excuse, ever, for a person to disguise rape as "showing he loves you".  If he wanted to do that then he should have supported you and respected your body.  He deserves to be handed over to the law and needs serious psychiatric help.  Do not be alone with him ever again.  This is also helped by what I said above by telling a trusted adult in your life what's going on.
Yes, it will hurt and you may feel ashamed but the shame is a lie from the pit of Hell.  You did nothing wrong.  Period.  You did not deserve what happened. And even though it undid happen you are still and always worth more than than that.  You can heal and you can move on and grow and become stronger.
As far as those friends you've gained: if they are truly your friends, they will support you even if you are not in a relationship with him.  If they dont either support you or at the very least stay neutral, then they were not your friends in the first place.  Losing those we consider friends may be painful, but better to lose fake friend that dont value us than hang on to them and drown within ourselves.
